{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% for periods with recent price spikes (last 3-5 days) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates > ±10% from 15-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture rebound potential.",
    "For 30-day horizon, reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is stable (no recent changes) to avoid overfitting to noise.",
    "If true outcome is consistently higher than forecast, shift forecast upward by 2-5% for next period to account for lagged momentum.",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a downtrend, increase forecast slope to reflect potential recovery."
  ]
}
